name: spin
script:
import sys, time, math, shutil

art = '''
_   _           _     ____  _           ____  _
| | | | __ _ ___| |__ |  _ ~| |_   _ ___|  _ ~| |_   _ ___
| |_| |/ _` / __| '_ ~| |_) | | | | / __| |_) | | | | / __|
|  _  | (_| ~__ ~ | | |  __/| | |_| ~__ ~  __/| | |_| ~__ ~
|_| |_|~__,_|___/_| |_|_|   |_|~__,_|___/_|   |_|~__,_|___/
'''.replace('~', chr(92)).strip('\n')

lines = art.splitlines()
width = max(len(line) for line in lines)
lines = [line.ljust(width) for line in lines]
terminal = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))

if width > terminal.columns - 2:
    new_width = terminal.columns - 2
    lines = [''.join(line[min(width - 1, round(x * (width - 1) / max(1, new_width - 1)))] for x in range(new_width)) for line in lines]
    width = new_width

angles = [0] * 12 + list(range(4, 181, 4)) + [180] * 12 + list(range(176, -1, -4))

try:
    sys.stdout.write('\033[?25l\033[2J')
    while True:
        for angle in angles:
            factor = abs(math.cos(math.radians(angle)))
            frame_width = max(1, round(width * factor))
            output = []
            for line in lines:
                source = line[::-1] if angle > 90 else line
                if frame_width == 1:
                    frame = '|'
                else:
                    frame = ''.join(source[round(x * (width - 1) / (frame_width - 1))] for x in range(frame_width))
                output.append(frame.center(terminal.columns))

            sys.stdout.write('\033[HPress CTRL+C to stop\n\n' + '\n'.join(output) + '\n\033[J')
            sys.stdout.flush()
            time.sleep(0.10)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pass
finally:
    sys.stdout.write('\033[?25h\033[0m\n')
    sys.stdout.flush()
